title: Globriva Drone — licensed recognizable 360 panorama replacements
notes: These files are verified by their Wikimedia Commons descriptions for a 2:1 360-degree aerial panorama, coordinates, and open reuse license. Visual composition still requires inspection of the actual four rendered faces.
Do not replace live catalog entries until the original imagery, R2 tiles and static face galleries are verified and served; old playable IDs must remain until replacements are ready.
The current drone publisher skips existing IDs and the readiness API requires five complete face galleries: adding metadata alone will not install photographs.
Attribution plus original link and the Creative Commons license must remain visible in gameplay, and adapted files should be identified appropriately.
